---
title: "2026-27 NBA contenders"
---

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## Takeaways
- **Built only from players:** each team's current roster (ESPN, November 2026), each player's 2025-26 offense and
  defense impact from lineups, and his 2025-26 minutes as a rough projection. No 2026-27 results are used.
- **Its track record, tested forward in time over 14 seasons:** an average 16% on the eventual champion among all 30 teams
  (a random pick gives 3%), with the champion in its top three half the time.
- Odds are a starting point before any games are played, not a prediction of injuries, trades or development.
:::

```{python}
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from _viz import read, md, show
c = read("step5_contenders_2027.csv").head(16).iloc[::-1]
fig = go.Figure()
fig.add_bar(y=c.team_display_name, x=c.title_prob, orientation="h", marker=dict(color="#2a78d6", line=dict(width=2, color="#fcfcfb")),
            text=[f"{p:.0%}" for p in c.title_prob], textposition="outside",
            customdata=c[["o_prev", "d_prev"]],
            hovertemplate="%{y}: %{x:.1%}<br>offense %{customdata[0]:+.1f}, defense %{customdata[1]:+.1f}<extra></extra>")
fig.update_layout(height=520, hovermode="closest", xaxis=dict(tickformat=".0%", range=[0, c.title_prob.max() * 1.25]),
                  margin=dict(l=10, r=40, t=20, b=10))
show(fig)
```

## Team details

*Offense* and *defense*: projected points per 100 possessions vs average, from players' 2025-26 impact. *Top players*:
the three with the most projected minutes and their impact. *Arrivals*: players with 1,000+ minutes last season who
changed teams. Players who change teams change archetype about 29% of the time, against 17% for those who stay (Step 3),
so roles for arrivals are less certain: Dončić kept his role after his trade, Bridges did not.

```{python}
d = read("step5_contenders_2027.csv").head(16)
d = d[["team_display_name", "title_prob", "o_prev", "d_prev", "age_w", "top_players", "key_arrivals", "main_roles"]]
d.columns = ["team", "title odds", "offense", "defense", "avg age", "top players (impact)", "arrivals", "main roles"]
d["title odds"] = d["title odds"].map(lambda x: f"{x:.1%}")
md(d.round(1).fillna("").to_markdown(index=False))
```

## Track record

Forward-chained: each season predicted from earlier seasons only.

```{python}
cv = read("step5_contenders_cv.csv")
cv["prob_on_champion"] = cv.prob_on_champion.map(lambda x: f"{x:.1%}")
cv.columns = ["season", "champion", "model's odds on champion", "champion's rank (of 30)"]
md(cv.to_markdown(index=False))
```

::: {.caveat}
WNBA: no 2027 roster file is available yet, so there is no WNBA forecast.
:::
